The '''First Bank of Coruscant''' was, during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]], one of the largest and most easily accessible banks of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was presumably based in the [[Financial District (Coruscant)/Legends|Financial District]].
